2608.02471.title: Action-grounded tissue affordance enables anticipatory auto-framing that lowers surgeon cognitive workload during laparoscopic surgery
2608.02471.paper_summary: Computational attention models could help surgeons manage the visual demands of laparoscopy, but they require dense spatial labels that are difficult to obtain because surgical intent is highly specialized and tacit. Here, we introduce DiffeoAfford, an action-grounded tissue affordance framework that retrospectively derives visual attention supervision from completed surgical procedures. By combining diffeomorphism-constrained tissue tracking with instrument trajectory analysis, DiffeoAfford generates affordance hotspot labels without manual per-frame annotation. A real-time prediction model trained on these labels anticipates relevant surgical regions and enables AffordView, an assistive auto-framing system for laparoscopic visualization. The proposed framework aligns with expert annotations and intraoperative surgeon gaze, and reduces surgeon cognitive workload during real-world evaluations using subjective, physiological, and behavioral measures.
2608.02471.paper_summary_zh: 計算注意力模型可以幫助外科醫生管理腹腔鏡手術的視覺需求，但它們需要密集的空間標籤，而這些標籤難以獲得，因為手術意圖高度專業且隱含。在這裡，我們介紹了DiffeoAfford，一個基於行動的組織物可用性框架，該框架從已完成的手術程序中回溯推導視覺注意力監督。通過將微分同構約束的組織追蹤與工具軌跡分析相結合，DiffeoAfford生成可用性熱點標籤，而無需手動逐幀標註。基於這些標籤訓練的實時預測模型預測相關的手術區域，並啟用AffordView，一個輔助自動框架系統，用於腹腔鏡可視化。所提出的框架與專家標註和術中外科醫生的凝視一致，並在使用主觀、生理和行為測量的現實評估中減少外科醫生的認知負擔。
